settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders are hand-packed within 2–3 business days. Domestic orders over $150 ship free, and most arrive within 5–7 business days.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We currently ship across the US and Canada. International orders are added as quick-strike drops throughout the year.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: Yes. Unused, undamaged pieces may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange. Seconds and final-sale items are excluded.

settings.question: My piece arrived damaged. What now?
settings.answer: We pack every piece by hand in plastic-free, compostable wraps. If something arrives broken, email a photo within 3 days and we will replace it free of charge.

settings.question: Are Terra pieces dishwasher and microwave safe?
settings.answer: Yes. Every piece is twice vitrified at 2200°F, making it dishwasher, microwave and oven safe. Avoid direct flame and sudden temperature shocks.

settings.question: Are the glazes lead-free?
settings.answer: Entirely. We use 100% lead-free, food-safe clay and glazes, and every batch is fired to food-safe certification standards.

settings.question: How is Terra Studios made?
settings.answer: Every piece is hand-pressed, glazed and fired in local workshops by our studio apprentices. This is why slight variations in form and glaze are part of the charm — no two pieces are identical.

settings.question: Where are your materials sourced?
settings.answer: All clay comes from local, ethical mineral reserves and our packaging is 100% plastic-free, recyclable and compostable.
